title: Nefald
description: Francophone community Minecraft RolePlay Geopolitics since 2012
body:
Nefald is an enriched Geopolitical / Survival Semi-RPG Minecraft server, hosted and independently managed by a non-profit association, offering an immersive and community gaming experience. 

**It is distinguished by a neat universe mixing**:
- ⚔️ RPG content - custom mobs, quests, unique objects
- 🏗️ Freedom of construction — open survival, protected land
- 💰 Player economy — shops, currency, exchanges
- 🎭 Strong visual identity — custom interface, custom items, coherent atmosphere
